entries.title: Three-act causal arc

inputs.purpose: Protagonist, concrete want, opposition, irreversible turn, and ending direction.

entries.outputIntent: Shape a goal-driven progression from setup through escalation to a changed equilibrium.
guidance: Use turning points to cause the next block rather than joining blocks with chronology alone.
Reserve the ending for proof of the story's change, not additional setup.
verifyCriteria: Each act changes the protagonist's available choices.
The final state resolves or transforms the opening dramatic question.
incompatibilities: A story intended to remain non-conflictual and observational.

entries.title: Four-part recontextualization

inputs.purpose: A world or relationship that can deepen before a recontextualizing turn.

entries.outputIntent: Build introduction, development, recontextualization, and reconciliation without forced escalation.
guidance: Let observation and accumulation carry the middle.
Make the turn change meaning rather than merely adding a larger obstacle.
verifyCriteria: The third block reinterprets established material.
The final block integrates the new meaning.
incompatibilities: A brief whose contract depends on continuous antagonist escalation.

entries.title: Nonlinear convergence

inputs.purpose: Distinct causal lines with an intended convergence or reveal.

entries.outputIntent: Arrange story order separately from event order while preserving orientation.
guidance: Give each line a stable visual or contextual orientation cue.
Place transitions where the new juxtaposition creates meaning or revelation.
verifyCriteria: The audience can identify the active line without explanatory text.
Convergence pays off information planted in each line.

entries.title: Associative mosaic

inputs.purpose: Approved images, memories, or emotional motifs.

entries.outputIntent: Create coherence through recurring motifs and emotional association rather than continuous scenes.
guidance: Let each fragment remain independently legible.
Use a recurring image, sound, or narration principle to bind fragments.
verifyCriteria: Every fragment advances the same emotional inquiry.
Associative cuts create a readable relation rather than random variety.
incompatibilities: A brief that requires precise continuous action across the whole piece.

entries.title: Bookend transformation

inputs.purpose: An approved image or situation that can return with changed meaning.

entries.outputIntent: Return to the opening composition or action after the story has changed its meaning.
guidance: Preserve enough visual structure for the rhyme to read.
Change only the states that express the story's transformation.
verifyCriteria: The closing image is recognizably related to the opening.
The changed details express the earned new meaning.
incompatibilities: A repeated image with no semantic change.

entries.title: Single-turn short

inputs.purpose: One situation, one tension, one irreversible turn, and one ending image.

entries.outputIntent: Enter late, turn once, and leave on the earliest complete image.
guidance: Spend the strongest visual and review attention on the turn and its consequence.
verifyCriteria: The piece has one dominant situation and turn.
The ending lands without an explanatory tail.
incompatibilities: Feature-scale beat compression presented as a short.

provenance.adaptation: Selected central containers were rewritten as neutral structural recipes; format-specific intake and policy remain pack responsibilities.
